what: A physically modeled electric piano (Rhodes and Wurlitzer 140B and 200A), vibraphone, and marimba with calibrated bark, studio stereo FX, a 6-point velocity curve editor, black-key velocity offset, arpeggiator, sequencer, and 31 factory presets. No samples.
author: Aaron Reichow

smk37.what: A physically modeled electric piano (Rhodes and Wurlitzer 140B and 200A), vibraphone, and marimba for the SMK-37, with calibrated bark, studio stereo FX, velocity curve editor, black-key velocity offset, arpeggiator, and 31 presets.
